announcements.text: The auto-switcher is RETIRED and no automation executes a route switch (owner order 2026-09-18). Enforcement is an OPT-IN gate, not a flag: scripts/sync_usage_logs.py runs the switcher leg only under an explicit --run-switch (`if args.run_switch:`, line 904), so --skip-switch is a DEPRECATED NO-OP that suppresses nothing (#152). The one production caller, tools/usage_logs_turn.sh:37, passes --skip-switch --skip-data --skip-scoreboard and no --run-switch, and --run-switch appears nowhere outside tests/test_sync_switch_optin.py. A bare run therefore cannot reach the switch; do not re-arm either path.
